import json,time
import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
start=time.perf_counter()
train=ad.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/train.h5ad')
x=np.asarray(train.X.toarray() if hasattr(train.X,'toarray') else train.X,dtype=np.float64)
ct=np.asarray(train.obs['cell_type'].astype(str))
condition=np.asarray(train.obs['condition'].astype(str))
donor=np.asarray(train.obs['replicate'].astype(str))
donors=sorted(set(donor))
records=[]
quantiles=[0,.25,.5,.9,.99,1]
for context in sorted(set(ct)):
    cm=(ct==context)&(condition=='control')
    sm=(ct==context)&(condition=='stimulated')
    pooled_c=(x[cm]>0).mean(axis=0)
    pooled_s=(x[sm]>0).mean(axis=0)
    counts=[];cf=[];sf=[]
    for name in donors:
        a=cm&(donor==name);b=sm&(donor==name)
        nc,ns=int(a.sum()),int(b.sum())
        counts.append([nc,ns])
        if nc and ns:
            cf.append((x[a]>0).mean(axis=0));sf.append((x[b]>0).mean(axis=0))
        else:cf.append(pooled_c);sf.append(pooled_s)
    raw_counts=np.asarray(counts,dtype=np.float64)
    valid=np.all(raw_counts>0,axis=1)
    counts=np.maximum(raw_counts,1)
    weights=valid/(1/counts[:,0]+1/counts[:,1]);weights/=weights.sum()
    pc=np.clip(cf,.005,.995);ps=np.clip(sf,.005,.995)
    effects=np.log(ps)-np.log1p(-ps)-np.log(pc)+np.log1p(-pc)
    average_effect=np.sum(weights[:,None]*effects,axis=0)
    denominator=max(1-np.sum(weights**2),1e-12)
    between=np.sum(weights[:,None]*(effects-average_effect)**2,axis=0)/denominator
    noise=1/(counts[:,0,None]*pc*(1-pc))+1/(counts[:,1,None]*ps*(1-ps))
    a=np.sum(weights[:,None]*noise,axis=0)
    p=np.sum(weights[:,None]**2*noise,axis=0)
    corrected_noise=np.maximum((a-p)/denominator,0)
    previous=np.maximum(between-a,0)+p
    proposed=np.maximum(between-corrected_noise,0)+p
    records.append({
        'context':context,
        'donor_weights':weights.tolist(),
        'effective_donors':float(1/np.sum(weights**2)),
        'noise_subtraction_ratio_quantiles':np.quantile(corrected_noise/a,quantiles).tolist(),
        'current_detection_uncertainty_quantiles':np.quantile(previous,quantiles).tolist(),
        'proposed_detection_uncertainty_quantiles':np.quantile(proposed,quantiles).tolist(),
        'current_positive_biological_variance_genes':int(np.sum(between>a)),
        'proposed_positive_biological_variance_genes':int(np.sum(between>corrected_noise)),
        'uncertainty_decreases_genes':int(np.sum(proposed<previous-1e-12)),
        'uncertainty_increases_genes':int(np.sum(proposed>previous+1e-12)),
        'mean_uncertainty_change':float(np.mean(proposed-previous)),
    })
result={
    'scope':'NEXT_RESEARCH_DETECTION_ONLY_WEIGHTED_NOISE_TRAINING_STATISTICS_NO_MODEL_FIT_PREDICTION_OR_DEV_TARGET',
